भारत में फ़िल्म की एडवांस बुकिंग मंगलवार 17 नवंबर को शुरू हुई और 24 घंटे के अंदर ही 10 करोड़ ग्रॉस का आंकड़ा पार हो गया। 💸

वर्ल्डवाइड भी फ़िल्म ने एडवांस बुकिंग में 150 मिलियन डॉलर से ज़्यादा की कमाई कर ली है, जो इसके भयंकर क्रेज़ को दिखाता है। 🌍

ctx.title: Avengers: Doomsday Box Office Advance Booking India: Sells 1 Lakh Tickets In Less Than 24 Hours, Eyes Hollywood’s Biggest Opening In India
ctx.summary:
Avengers: Doomsday has crossed the 10 crore mark in India in less than 24 hours. It is eyeing a massive opening in India on December 17.  
 The post  Avengers: Doomsday Box Office Advance Booking India: Sells 1 Lakh Tickets In Less Than 24 Hours, Eyes Hollywood’s Biggest Opening In India  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Avengers: Doomsday is now less than a month away from its grand theatrical release in India. Owing to the massive market share Marvel commands in the country, the film will be released a day earlier in India than it will be worldwide on December 18. Meanwhile, advance bookings for the film opened in the country on Tuesday, November 17, and it is already headed for a historic opening day.
The upcoming Marvel film is easily among the most anticipated films of 2026. There are several theories about the film, and fans are excited. For FDFS (First Day First Show), shows begin as early as midnight. It is rare for a film to secure midnight shows as its first shows of the day. Additionally, ticket prices have risen to as much as 4,000 in some theaters. All this hints at a massive opening day for the Marvel film.
Doomsday has crossed the 10 crore gross mark in its opening-day advance sales in less than 24 hours after bookings commenced. Around 1 lakh tickets have been sold across multiplex chains in the country. The early tickets were also priced on the high side, with some theaters seeing record-high ticket prices. Cinepolis in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, priced its midnight show at 4,300 per ticket. With such pricing, Doomsday is headed for a historic opening day in the country. It has already surpassed the advance collections of Endgame and No Way Home in their first 24 hours.
Earlier this year, Tom Holland’s Spider-Man: Brand New Day bagged the biggest opening for a Hollywood movie in India. It earned over 60 crore in India on Day 1. At the current pace and with the buzz surrounding the film, Avengers: Doomsday is very likely to surpass Brand New Day.
The craze for Avengers: Doomsday is not limited to India. The film has reportedly crossed a staggering $150 million in worldwide advance ticket sales, underlining the extraordinary anticipation surrounding its release. Its premium-format presales alone generated an impressive $16.5 million within the first 24 hours.
Adding to the global buzz, the film’s first full-length trailer clocked an extraordinary 503 million views in its first 24 hours, making it the second-biggest movie trailer launch in history. The film has also reportedly set presales milestones in international markets, including the UK and Brazil. Trade projections suggest a potential $1 billion -plus opening weekend, putting it in contention for an all-time global box-office record.
